description: Universal rubric supporting RCM, BCM, and BM call types with adaptive criteria

RCM_TELE_PD.name: RCM Telephone Personal Discussion
RCM_TELE_PD.description: Two-party phone call between RCM and Customer

BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.name: BCM Physical PD Self-Audio
BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.description: Single-party narration by BCM describing physical visits

BM_AUDIO_FI.name: BM Audio Field Investigation
BM_AUDIO_FI.description: Single-party narration by BM describing field verification

RCM_TELE_PD.criterion: Recording disclosure made at the start of the call
RCM_TELE_PD.probe: Inform the customer the call is being recorded for loan verification. / 'Yeh call recording par hai, loan verification ke liye.'
RCM_TELE_PD.what_to_look_for: RCM explicitly tells customer the call is being recorded at the beginning

BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.probe: Application ID, customer name, village/town, product, loan amount applied — stated at the start. Confirm pre-visit preparation: CRIF/CIBIL bureau report reviewed.
BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.what_to_look_for: BCM states application ID, customer name, loan amount at the start of narration

BM_AUDIO_FI.probe: Date, location, purpose of field investigation stated at the start
BM_AUDIO_FI.what_to_look_for: BM states date, location, and purpose of visit

RCM_TELE_PD.criterion: Identity validated — RCM is speaking to the MAIN BORROWER himself/herself
RCM_TELE_PD.probe: Confirm full name, and that the speaker is the applicant (not relative, DSA, agent). Cross-check mobile number. 'Aap khud [name] bol rahe hain?'
RCM_TELE_PD.what_to_look_for: Customer confirms their own identity and that the phone number belongs to them

BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.criterion: All visits confirmed — when and whom
BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.probe: Date/time of each visit (business, residence, collateral), who was met at each, who accompanied. Borrower met personally at business.
BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.what_to_look_for: BCM narrates dates/times of visits, who was present, confirms meeting borrower

BM_AUDIO_FI.probe: What was verified (documents, property, business), who was present
BM_AUDIO_FI.what_to_look_for: BM states what was verified and who was present during verification

RCM_TELE_PD.criterion: Customer confirms having applied for the loan (application awareness)
RCM_TELE_PD.probe: 'Aapne Prodigee Finance mein loan ke liye file lagayi hai?' — customer should know an application exists.
RCM_TELE_PD.what_to_look_for: Customer voluntarily confirms they applied for a loan with Prodigee

BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.probe: Geo-tagged photos — business premises, QR codes, signboard, stock, bills, neighbor signboards, residence photos — confirmed taken & uploaded.
BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.what_to_look_for: BCM confirms photos were taken and uploaded during visits

BM_AUDIO_FI.probe: Photos, document copies, verification records captured
BM_AUDIO_FI.what_to_look_for: BM confirms documentation was captured during field investigation

RCM_TELE_PD.probe: Speak in the customer's preferred language; confirm the customer can hear and understand.
RCM_TELE_PD.what_to_look_for: Both parties communicate clearly in preferred language, no comprehension issues

BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.probe: Recorded same day after all visits; 15–30 minutes total.
BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.what_to_look_for: BCM confirms recording made same day; check duration is 15-30 minutes

BM_AUDIO_FI.probe: Recording made on the day of field visit
BM_AUDIO_FI.what_to_look_for: BM confirms recording made on day of visit

RCM_TELE_PD.probe: Establish who the co-borrowers are and speak with them on this call, or record that a separate co-borrower call will be made.
RCM_TELE_PD.what_to_look_for: Co-borrowers identified; either spoken to on call or separate call logged

BM_AUDIO_FI.probe: Not applicable to BM field investigations

RCM_TELE_PD.requirement: Valid recording exists — audible both sides, materially complete, duration ≥ 10 minutes
The RCM spoke to the ACTUAL applicant (not relative, DSA, agent)
Recording disclosure was made to the customer at the start of the call
Customer clearly understands this is a LOAN AGAINST PROPERTY — property mortgaged, original title documents deposited
Customer is aware of the loan amount applied (stated within ±10% of CAM amount)
No restricted end use surfaced (speculation, new/unrelated business, milch animals, illegal activity)
No mis-selling — no false promises, no misquoting, no coaching answers
No negative-profile revelation left unescalated (PEP, negative industry, ST-property)
Every red flag raised is recorded with escalation note

BCM_PHYSICAL_PD.requirement: Valid recording — ≥ 15 minutes, audible, recorded SAME DAY after all visits
BCM personally met the MAIN BORROWER at business premises
EVERY declared income business/site physically visited
Residence AND collateral visited; family and co-borrower spoken to
Neighbor verification done — at least 2 business + 2 residence neighbors
Collateral papers physically seen — original title documents sighted
Narration consistent with geo-tagged photos uploaded on PRAGATI

BM_AUDIO_FI.requirement: Valid recording — audible, complete, recorded same day as field visit
BM personally met the borrower and verified identity
No discrepancies between documents and ground reality left unreported
